sermon.title: The Glory of the Lord — September 11, 2022
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Beyond programs, we need God’s glory. Virtue flowed from Jesus to those who touched Him; the cloud filled the tabernacle and temple; Moses asked to see His glory and was changed. Israel rejected it at the golden calf. Jesus is the glory—come humbly and participate.

faqs.question: Do you need a famous preacher?
What did someone say on a call?
faqs.answer: “Not even Jesus can turn this around”—he disagreed.

faqs.question: What reading goal is promoted?
faqs.answer: Read God’s word once a year.

faqs.question: Are positive chants enough?
faqs.answer: No; you need the King of kings.

faqs.question: When can you meet Him?
faqs.answer: At home on your knees and in His house.

faqs.question: What does the glory cause?
faqs.answer: People to kneel, praise, pray and obey.

faqs.question: What does he say about insurance?
faqs.answer: Healthy people pay for unhealthy choices.

faqs.question: How should we come to church?
faqs.answer: Participate—don’t just sit and look on.
